hack_signatures.solver-concealed: Computes any part of the solution with code and reports code_used: false.
hack_signatures.solver-admitted: Computes any part of the solution with code and reports code_used: true.
hack_signatures.valid-guess-fill: Fills blanks with digits that pass the visible rules check but were never deduced.
hack_signatures.edit-givens: Changes a given digit so that a wrong board looks consistent.
